app_type: hybrid single-file PWA music app (vanilla JS + Tailwind CDN)

persona_and_principles.fusion: Mixes liquid glassmorphism, organic curved bubble geometry, ambient visualizer physics, and high-density audio controls
persona_and_principles.negative_space: Detached floating capsules with wide surrounding margins to let wallpapers and ambient light orbs breathe
persona_and_principles.contrast: Specular rim highlights (inner inset white highlights) against translucent deep-slate dark and frosted light glass

surface_level_1.name: Base Layout Shell & Backdrop Containers
surface_level_1.css: background: rgba(10, 10, 18, 0.45); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(160%); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);

surface_level_2.name: Floating Bubble Cards & Grid Containers
surface_level_2.classes: rounded-3xl bg-white/[0.06] backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/15 shadow-xl hover:bg-white/[0.10] hover:border-white/25 transition-all duration-300
surface_level_2.css: background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(180%); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);

surface_level_3.name: Floating Controls, Mini Player, Floating Navs & Modals
surface_level_3.classes: rounded-full bg-white/[0.12] backdrop-blur-3xl border border-white/25 shadow-2xl
surface_level_3.css: background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); backdrop-filter: blur(36px) saturate(200%); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28); box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35), 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);

desktop_sidebar.structure: Detached floating glass panel with 16px/24px margin from window edges
desktop_sidebar.styling: m-4 lg:m-6 rounded-[32px] bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/15 shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] p-5 flex flex-col justify-between h-[calc(100vh-2rem)] sticky top-4 z-40
desktop_sidebar.active_item: rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--treesh-purple)] to-purple-600 text-white shadow-[0_0_20px_var(--treesh-purple-glow)] font-semibold scale-[1.02]

top_bar.structure: Floating capsule top bar detached from header boundaries with glass search & mic bubbles
top_bar.styling: mx-4 my-3 lg:mx-6 rounded-full bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/20 px-6 py-3 shadow-xl flex items-center justify-between sticky top-3 z-30
top_bar.search_button: rounded-full bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 px-4 py-2 border border-white/15 text-sm flex items-center gap-2 backdrop-blur-md transition-all active:scale-95

mobile_bottom_nav.structure: Floating pill capsule suspended above screen bottom
mobile_bottom_nav.styling: fixed bottom-4 left-4 right-4 h-16 rounded-full bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-3xl border border-white/20 shadow-[0_15px_35px_rgba(0,0,0,0.7)] flex items-center justify-around px-2 z-40 md:hidden
mobile_bottom_nav.active_bubble_indicator: absolute h-12 rounded-full bg-[var(--treesh-purple)] shadow-[0_0_25px_var(--treesh-purple-glow)] transition-all duration-300 ease-out -z-10

floating_mini_player.structure: Detached floating capsule docked above mobile bottom nav or bottom-right on desktop
floating_mini_player.styling: fixed bottom-22 left-4 right-4 md:bottom-6 md:right-6 md:left-auto md:w-96 rounded-3xl p-3 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-3xl border border-white/25 shadow-[0_20px_45px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] z-30 flex items-center gap-3 hover:scale-[1.01] transition-transform
floating_mini_player.album_art: w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl object-cover shadow-md border border-white/20

now_playing_screen.structure: Full-screen immersive liquid glass visualizer with ambient blurred album canvas
now_playing_screen.styling: fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-3xl flex flex-col justify-between p-6 lg:p-12 overflow-y-auto
now_playing_screen.vinyl_cover: w-72 h-72 sm:w-96 sm:h-96 rounded-[36px] shadow-[0_30px_70px_rgba(0,0,0,0.9)] border border-white/20 object-cover mx-auto transform hover:rotate-1 transition-transform duration-500
now_playing_screen.karaoke_lyrics: text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold leading-relaxed space-y-4 my-6 text-white/40 active-verse:text-white active-verse:bg-white/10 active-verse:backdrop-blur-xl active-verse:p-4 active-verse:rounded-2xl active-verse:shadow-lg transition-all

modals_and_sheets.styling: rounded-[36px] bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-3xl border border-white/20 p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-[0_25px_60px_-15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] max-w-2xl w-full mx-auto animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200

toasts.styling: fixed top-6 right-6 z-50 rounded-full px-6 py-3 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-[var(--treesh-purple)] text-white shadow-[0_10px_30px_var(--treesh-purple-glow)] flex items-center gap-3 font-medium text-sm animate-bounce-subtle

reorganized_settings_information_archite.philosophy: Grouped logically into 5 intuitive sections with a top Quick Settings hero area for common toggles. Eliminates cognitive overload for average users while keeping power features available.

top_quick_settings.title: ⚡ Quick Settings
items: Performance Mode Toggle (Disables blurs for low-end hardware)
Equalizer Preset Selector (Bass Boost, Pop, Vocal, Acoustic)

groups.title: 🎨 Appearance & Personalization
groups.description: Customize theme, accent color, background wallpapers, fonts, and visual effects

groups.title: 🎵 Audio & Playback
groups.description: Adjust sound quality, equalizer, crossfade transitions, and vocal performer settings

groups.title: 🎙️ Voice & Assistant
groups.description: Configure voice control, hands-free commands, and navigation shortcuts

groups.title: 🔒 Account, Data & Security
groups.description: Manage user profile, parental controls, app locks, storage, and cross-device syncing

groups.title: ⚙️ System, Backup & About
groups.description: Accessibility settings, sleep timer details, backup lyrics, version info, and reset
items: Accessibility (High Contrast, Motion Reduction, Color Vision)

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--treesh-purple)] to-purple-600 text-white font-semibold px-6 py-3 shadow-[0_0_20px_var(--treesh-purple-glow)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_var(--treesh-purple-glow)] hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all duration-200
buttons.secondary: rounded-full bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/20 text-white font-medium px-5 py-2.5 backdrop-blur-md active:scale-95 transition-all duration-200
buttons.icon_bubble: rounded-full p-3 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/20 text-white backdrop-blur-md active:scale-90 transition-all duration-200 shadow-md

chips_and_pills.filter_pill: rounded-full border border-white/15 bg-white/5 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-white/15 active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer select-none backdrop-blur-sm
chips_and_pills.active_pill: rounded-full bg-[var(--treesh-purple)] text-white font-semibold px-4 py-2 text-sm shadow-[0_0_15px_var(--treesh-purple-glow)] cursor-pointer

inputs_and_controls.text_input: w-full rounded-full bg-white/10 border border-white/20 px-5 py-3 text-white placeholder-white/40 focus:outline-none focus:border-[var(--treesh-purple)] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[var(--treesh-purple-glow)] backdrop-blur-md transition-all
inputs_and_controls.range_slider: accent-[var(--treesh-purple)] h-2 rounded-lg bg-white/20 appearance-none cursor-pointer
inputs_and_controls.toggle_switch: w-12 h-6 rounded-full bg-white/20 p-1 cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out relative peer-checked:bg-[var(--treesh-purple)]

performance_and_accessibility.perf_mode_override: When html.perf-mode is active: replace backdrop-blur with solid semi-transparent surfaces (bg-slate-900/90), disable CSS background ambient orb animations and heavy drop-shadows.
performance_and_accessibility.reduce_motion_override: When html.reduce-motion or prefers-reduced-motion is active: set transition duration to 0.01ms and transform scale effects to none.
performance_and_accessibility.light_theme_override: When html.theme-light is active: adapt glass backgrounds to white-based translucent glass (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-2xl), dark text (#0f0f15), and subtle dark borders (border-black/10).

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: All interactive buttons, inputs, navigation links, tabs, sliders, and audio controls MUST include descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="nav-library-button", data-testid="mini-player-play-btn", data-testid="settings-tab-appearance", data-testid="quick-theme-toggle").
